title: queue.rs: silent .env removal suppression unexplained
description: queue.rs drain_once line 255: 'let _ = tokio::fs::remove_file(&env_path).await;' silently discards the result. The immediately preceding block logs warn! for .msg removal failure. The asymmetry is unexplained. A contributor will not know if the silence was intentional. Given stoa-4315538d.4, the .env should be logged on failure too, or the silence needs a comment explaining why orphaned .env files are benign (they are not — they accumulate).
